card.name: Numbers inside dose tables
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point or number word just before or inside a dose amount in dosing tables, such as a reduced or converted dose in mg, g or mL.

modes.label: Space before a dose amount
modes.description: The blank space right before a new number and unit in a dose list or reduction step.
modes.example: 11.5 mg daily<< >>11.5 mg every other day

modes.label: Inside a decimal or number word
modes.description: The decimal point, a leading digit, or a spelled-out number inside a dose amount.
modes.example: 250 mL 250 mg (50 mL) Final Volume 300 mL 0<<.>>83 mg per mL 10
